messages:
Renee (CSE): FYI ArborTech flipped on Conversations for two new product teams (Support + Sales Assist). Early telemetry shows sustained multi-turn sessions and intermittent throttling. They want: predictable per-seat cost, lower tail latency, and a way to isolate noisy teams. cc @Omar @Vik @Priya

Omar (CS Ops): Can you share qps per team and typical seq lengths? Real-time or async?

Renee (CSE): Support: ~80 seats, avg prompt 1.8k tokens, reply ~400 tokens, peak ~4 reqs/sec/seat. Sales Assist: ~30 seats, longer replies ~900 tokens, peak ~2 reqs/sec/seat. Combined tenant qps ~420 with bursts to ~900. Spikes correlate with end-of-day reports. Renewal in 5 weeks; they flagged cost predictability as a renewal blocker.

Vik (Eng-runtime): Sounds like batching + KV cache churn. Short-term we can: 1) add per-team concurrency caps, 2) enable tenant pinning to a trial dedicated pool, 3) increase KV retention for Support only. Long-term recommend Dedicated for SLAs.

Priya (AE): I'll propose a 10-day dedicated trial targeted at Support (they're most critical). Need an estimate of cost delta and expected tail latency improvement to present to Exec Sponsor.

Claire (Product): Product feedback: customers keep asking for "team-level quotas" in the console and a per-team cost estimator. Logging: they'd like message-level team tagging in audit logs. Adding to roadmap.

Renee (CSE): Sanity payload sample from Support (sanitized):
```json
{ "model": "redwood-chat-large-2025", "messages": ["user: ticket history... ~1.7k tokens","assistant: ..."], "max_tokens": 800 }
```
They also noted missing team metadata in the UI when filtering traces.

Vik (Eng-runtime): I'll open infra ticket INF-9009 for KV retention toggle + canary route. Quick config we can try for the trial (canary only):
```yaml
tenant: arbortech-support
kv_retention: extended
batch_window_ms: 20
team_concurrency: 6
pinned_pool: dedicated-trial-small
```

Omar (CS Ops): OPS-7777 opened to request a dedicated trial pool and a temporary quota increase. ETA for provisioning ~18h.

Priya (AE): I'll prepare two renewal scenarios: A) seat-based + burst credits (cheaper short-term), B) committed Dedicated pool (predictable monthly). If trial shows <25% cost increase and >40% tail error reduction, I'll recommend option B.

quota-bot: Dedicated trial pool `dedicated-trial-small` allocated to tenant arbortech-support (expires in 10 days).

Renee (CSE): Plan: 1) Vik -> INF-9009 + apply trial config once pool ready, 2) Omar -> OPS-7777 follow-up for quotas, 3) Priya -> renewal scenarios + exec brief, 4) Claire -> collect requirements for per-team quotas and logging. I'll schedule an enablement session with Support ops on Tue.

Vik (Eng-runtime): Deployed canary config to trial pool. Monitoring dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/tenants/arbortech/support/canary (will post SLI numbers in 2h).

Renee (CSE): Good. Capture metrics we'll need: p50/p90/p99 latency, 429s/timeouts rate, tokens per minute, and cost delta per team. I'll post results and customer feedback here. Renewal risk: medium until trial confirms predictability. :spiral_notepad:
